text:
tara: quick proposal for the chat/completions shape — default to a `messages` array with roles (system/user/assistant). keeps tool-calling + structured output simple and aligns with web+open-source models.

mike: +1 on messages as default. major ask from infra: we need a compact `prompt` alias for tiny clients and legacy usage (read-only). can be deprecated later.

alicia: customer asks we heard: some partners want `prompt: string` because it's what their SDKs use. we need a migration story and clear diff in docs. also: define behavior when both `prompt` and `messages` are provided.

jon: tradeoffs: messages gives explicit role semantics (good for tool routing). `prompt` is ambiguous and encourages system-role misuse. runtime: message parsing cost is negligible. biggest cost is token count drift during migration.

mike: note: tool/function calling depends on roles — system message is authoritative for tool permissions. if we allow `prompt`, we should treat it as a user message (not system) to avoid accidental privilege escalation.

alicia: launch gates we should require: 1) SDK parity (python/js), 2) migration guide with examples for common patterns, 3) evals that check role-sensitive regressions, 4) deprecation policy for `prompt`.

mike: operational asks: add a compatibility flag in the runtime `compat_prompt_mode` so teams can opt-in to interpret `prompt` as user text only. helps Dedicated/Private customers.

tara: proposal for API surface: - POST /v1/chat/completions expects either `messages: [{role,name?,content}]` or `prompt: string` (legacy). if both present we error with 400 unless `compat_prompt_mode=true`. example:```json
{
  "model":"redwood-chat-1",
  "messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the report."}]
}```

jon: suggestion: add explicit `role` enum validation and limit system messages to root or first position in the array for the initial launch to reduce ambiguous sequences. longer-term we can relax.

alicia: customer-driven prioritization: enterprise customers (3 pilot accounts) require a guarantee that system messages cannot be overwritten by later assistant content and need an audit log for system->tool calls. include as part of Private deployment checklist.

mike: rollout plan: alpha on hosted API (canary for 48h), then SDK updates, then Dedicated opt-in, then Private deployable package. timeline: 3 weeks spec + SDK + docs, 2 weeks canary, 1 week sweep.

tara: launch criteria (final): - spec merged + examples - SDKs ship + tests - migration guide published - evals show <1% regression on role-sensitive prompts - e2e canary healthy 48h - support playbook ready

alicia: scope negotiation: deferring: multi-role namespacing (team-admin/system variants), message-level expiration TTL, and compact binary wire format — put into backlog for Q3.

jon: open questions: do we normalize assistant messages with `name` required when role=assistant and multiple assistants? probably not for v1.

deploy-bot: canary deployment started for `chat-completions/messages-default` on hosted region us-west-2 at 1777771250 :rocket:

mike: action items: tara -> write PR for API spec and edge cases; mike -> perf delta & compat flag impl plan; alicia -> craft customer comms + migration FAQ; jon -> add role validation tests to eval harness.

tara: thanks — i'll draft the API doc this afternoon and tag owners. :thumbsup:
